articles.title: Petrol pump staffer hurt in attack over fuel payment dispute
articles.description: An alleged armed attack at a petrol pump near Dana Mandi in Sultanpur Lodhi, Kapurthala district, left an employee seriously injured after a dispute over fuel payment reportedly turned violent in broad daylight.
